## request (npm) 2.88.2 · keep but plan an exit

Deprecated on npm since February 2020 and archived on GitHub [S1, S2]. CVE-2023-28155 affects 2.88.2 with no fix coming [S4]. It still works: keep it for now and move the services that follow redirects from user-supplied URLs first.

| | |
|---|---|
| Latest | 2.88.2 (2020-02-11) [S1] |
| License | Apache-2.0 [S1] |
| Downloads | not read (rate-limited) |
| Open advisories | 1 [S3] |

**Maintenance.** No release in the last 24 months, no commits, repository archived. Deprecation text: "request has been deprecated, see https://github.com/request/request/issues/3142" [S1, S5].

**Security.**

| Advisory | Severity | Affected | Fixed |
|---|---|---|---|
| GHSA-p8p7-x288-28g6 / CVE-2023-28155: SSRF via cross-protocol redirect | CVSS 6.1 (GitHub) | <= 2.88.2 | none |

**License.** Apache-2.0, no change found. Keep its NOTICE file. Not legal advice.

**Alternatives.**

| | License | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js fetch | MIT | no dependency; no pipe-style streams |
| undici | MIT | maintained by Node.js; lower-level |
| got | MIT | closest feature match; ESM-only from v12 |

**Not verified.** Weekly downloads (npm API 429), dependents (deps.dev timeout), alternatives' release dates.
